item.title: Bridge collapses in Kesarganj, five dead
item.content:encoded:
The Kesarganj bridge over the Ganga collapsed on Thursday evening, killing five people and injuring twelve, district officials said. Rescue teams from the NDRF reached the site within two hours and pulled survivors from the water.

The bridge was built in 2009 and had been flagged for repairs in a 2024 state audit. The district magistrate has ordered an inquiry and said a report will be submitted within fifteen days. Traffic has been diverted through the old highway.
